text:
Jordan: Candidate verbally accepted but countered with a request: keep base + $5k sign-on (within band) AND accelerate first equity vest by 3 months to offset notice period. Is equity acceleration allowed as part of an exception?

Mira: Equity accelerations are unusual. We typically do cash sign-on or retention bonuses. Who's the manager and what's the business case?

Kyle (Recruiter): Manager is Emma (Platform). Candidate has a 2-month garden-leave and will lose one scheduled grant cliff. Manager says candidate is mission-critical for new infra rollout and requests one-quarter acceleration for first grant only. Start date stays same (after notice).

Jordan: So ask = $5k sign-on + accelerate 3 months of first RSU cliff. Band cap unaffected by $5k (it's within L5). Need Comp Committee for equity exceptions?

People Ops Bot: Reminder: equity modifications (acceleration/re-pricing) require Equity Ops + Comp Committee approval. Cash sign-ons within band do not need committee if <= cap and manager approved. Attach signed offer and manager justification.

Mira: Equity Ops note  acceleration may trigger tax withholding and accounting entries. We need Equity Ops to confirm expense treatment and Finance to note FASB impact. Also check policy: acceleration only for retention scenarios; need documented reason and limited to first grant.

Kyle (Recruiter): Pasting comp details:
```
Base: $170,000
Level: L5
Sign-on requested: $5,000 (one-time)
Equity: standard grant (4-year, 1-year cliff) -> request accelerate cliff by 3 months for first grant only
Justification: candidate loses scheduled cliff due to garden-leave; critical hire for infra rollout; manager requests one-off to avoid losing candidate
Start: aligned to end of notice period
```

Jordan: My asks: 1) confirm whether Comp Committee/Eq Ops will approve a 3-month one-time cliff acceleration, 2) confirm any tax/accounting implications and whether candidate must sign addendum.

Comp Committee: Acknowledged. We'll consult Equity Ops and Finance. Please attach grant terms and candidate's notice dates in HR ticket. We'll aim for a decision within 48 hours.

Payroll: Note that accelerated vesting will create supplemental income in the pay period if shares are taxable at vest. Need to know timing to withhold appropriately.

Mira: Uploading details to HR-1011. Recommend treating this as "one-off equity accommodation" and documenting precedent. Also require candidate to sign addendum acknowledging acceleration is conditional and not indicative of future policy.

Kyle (Recruiter): Candidate agreeable to addendum. If approved, they can sign via DocuSign within the day.

People Ops Bot: Routing: equity exceptions -> @comp-committee + @equity-ops + @finance. Added urgency flag.

Jordan: Thanks all. I'll wait for committee + equity ops. Please post final decision here so I can finalize with candidate. :thumbsup:
